description: Get activity metrics for a politician broken down by period (30d, 90d, 1y, all-time). Includes buy/sell counts and values per period, most traded tickers (top 10), and transaction type breakdown. Useful for analyzing trading patterns over time.

slug.description: Politician URL slug (e.g., "sen-nancy-pelosi") Lowercase letters, digits and single hyphens only, exactly as returned by get_politicians (a name with spaces or capitals is rejected).

name: get_politician_activity
